The split is not cosmetic. This config needs `lib: DOM`, which makes `fetch` and
`WebSocket` typed globals. In backend code that would silently remove one of the
three layers enforcing that FetchPolicyGate is the only network path — so src/,
test/ and tools/ are typechecked against tsconfig.backend.json, where DOM is
absent and a bare `fetch` is still a type error.
The UI itself issues no HTTP of its own: server actions talk to Postgres through
Prisma directly. ESLint's no-restricted-globals and tools/check-no-raw-http.ts both
cover app/ as well, so the ban survives the DOM lib being available here.
